package.title: Copper Voltage Drop — Steel Conduit
package.shortDescription: Voltage-drop reference data for uncoated copper conductors installed in steel conduit.
package.longDescription: This package provides conductor-level voltage-drop reference values for uncoated copper conductors in steel conduit at 60 Hz and 75 C. It is intended for lookup, comparison, and supported Acadia Terminal calculations.
package.verificationStatus: Verified against the published source material

package.useNote: Use this package as a technical reference. Confirm project conditions, conductor properties, code requirements, and engineering assumptions before applying results to a design.
